title: The SpawnFn options param still declares `{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit'…
body: The SpawnFn options param still declares `{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit' | 'pipe' }`, a node-era shape that Bun.spawnSync ignores (the default impl hardcodes per-stream inherit and never reads options). Vestigial but harmless; could be trimmed to just what the seam needs for clarity.
